title: Glyph compositor endpoint and exemplar promotion

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
User-approved 28-slice proposal, exact scope, verification cadence, rollback units, promotion gates, and hard stops.

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:real-katex-glyph-compositor; npm run typecheck; npm run visual:glyph-reconciliation-experiment
verificationRecords.notes: 26 focused tests and all TypeScript projects pass. The stable visual entrypoint captured 10 overview and 14 dense wide/phone endpoint frames; material progress 99.9 percent visibly compresses plus, rule, and glyph geometry before native KaTeX snaps cleanly at 100 percent.

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:real-katex-glyph-compositor; npm run typecheck
verificationRecords.notes: 28 focused tests and all TypeScript projects pass. Immutable renderer-session observations cover material/native side, paint identity, semantic/group ownership, rectangles, baseline, wrapper transform, paint/style fingerprints, and rule geometry; invalid geometry, cross-document elements, and durable artifact leakage fail closed.

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:real-katex-glyph-compositor; npm run typecheck
verificationRecords.notes: 30 focused tests and all TypeScript projects pass. Material owner identities correlate deterministically to native targets only through reconciliation dispositions and tracks; merge, split, and departing multiplicity are explicit, while duplicate tracks, missing target coverage, and unbacked target IDs fail closed.

28 existing Chromium checks passed; the new check failed because at least one correlated material/native glyph style fingerprint differs. The provisional equality assertion was invalid for a microscope whose purpose is to reveal that difference, so the telemetry remains and the assertion will preserve both fingerprints without assuming parity.

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:real-katex-glyph-compositor; npm run typecheck; npm run test:browser:real-katex-glyph-compositor; npm run visual:glyph-reconciliation-experiment
verificationRecords.notes: 30 focused tests, all TypeScript projects, 29 Chromium checks, and 24 stable overview/endpoint captures pass. Across wide and phone DPR profiles, correlated track rectangles are within roughly 0.1 CSS px, but the persistent plus clone retains source font size 65.824 versus 46.0768 wide and 46.464 versus 32.5248 phone; this generic 1.43 scale mismatch explains the visible overflow and baseline delta. The initial fingerprint-equality hypothesis was recorded failed and replaced by comparison evidence.

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:real-katex-glyph-compositor; npm run typecheck; npm run test:browser:real-katex-glyph-compositor; npm run visual:glyph-reconciliation-experiment
verificationRecords.notes: 30 focused tests, all TypeScript projects, 30 Chromium checks, and 24 capture frames pass. Generic horizontal rule telemetry is repeatable at wide and phone DPR: material/native border style and thickness match exactly, length differs about 0.016 CSS px, position residual stays below 0.08 px, and clipping remains none. Structural rule geometry is not the visible handoff cause.
30 tests passed; controller and lifecycle budgets remain enforced.
Application, node, test, and domain TypeScript checks passed.
31 Chromium tests passed. Ownership is atomic and seek-direction independent; 99.9% evidence retains the material/native glyph baseline residual while glyph boxes and rules remain subpixel-close.

35 focused tests passed. Consensus, inverse, tolerance, outlier, paint, style, shape, maximum-bound, and invalid-input paths are covered; the measured fraction plus style ratio returns unsupported instead of a per-glyph correction.
Application, node, test, and domain TypeScript checks passed.

allowedWork: Stable dense endpoint diagnostics, one bounded common alignment correction, generic scene compositor evolution, and only the named split, radical, reader, and compound exemplars with focused evidence.
disallowedWork: No notation, operation, viewport, card, or expression exceptions; durable renderer state; clone semantic authority; global rollout; unrelated dirty-worktree edits; Manim, CAS, live LLM, or curriculum work.
goal: Resolve or bound the generic native KaTeX endpoint jerk, then prove inverse split, radical succession, one reader card, and one compound presentation without new lifecycle or scheduling categories.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging and its completed Theseus evidence.
stopConditions: Stop if any notation, operation, viewport, expression, or card-specific offset, matcher, lifecycle, track, or scheduler is required.
Stop if clone/native identity depends on visual equality or DOM order instead of canonical reconciliation lineage.
Stop if the endpoint correction is not one bounded common scene-level correction or changes native DOM.
Stop if any painted source or target atom is implicit, unowned, duplicated, or unstable.
Stop if DOM nodes, computed styles, geometry, tracks, keyframes, or backend plans enter durable semantic or reader artifacts.
Stop if moving clones gain accessibility, hover, focus, annotation, Cloze, or export authority.
Stop if a promoted exemplar introduces a notation or operation-specific lifecycle or scheduling category.
Stop if the retained endpoint residual grows beyond its measured bound or becomes a semantic or accessibility defect.
Stop on performance, payload, accessibility, semantic, reader, review, production, static-JS, export, seek, rewind, or responsive regression.
Stop if work broadens beyond the four named exemplars or touches unrelated dirty-worktree changes.
Stop if a required automated or visual gate fails without one bounded generic correction.

slices.title: endpoint-reproduction-harness
slices.summary: Added deterministic fraction-local 96–100 percent wide/phone endpoint captures to the stable visual command; reproduced the material-scene geometry compression at 99.9 percent and clean native target snap at 100 percent without changing runtime behavior.

slices.title: endpoint-telemetry-contract
slices.summary: Defined immutable renderer-session handoff telemetry for material/native paint identity, geometry, baselines, wrapper transforms, paint/style fingerprints, and rule geometry; invalid data, cross-document elements, and durable artifact leakage fail closed without adding a production module.

slices.title: clone-native-atom-correlation
slices.summary: Added deterministic handoff correlations from material owner IDs to native target atoms through reconciliation disposition and track identities, with explicit departing tracks and total merge/split coverage; duplicates, missing targets, and unbacked IDs fail closed.

slices.title: baseline-and-style-microscope
slices.summary: Added repeatable wide/phone/DPR glyph handoff telemetry and stable capture evidence. Track rectangles already coincide within about 0.1 CSS px; the persistent plus clone instead retains a source font roughly 1.43 times the target numerator font, causing generic paint overflow and baseline drift at handoff.

slices.title: structural-rule-microscope
slices.summary: Added generic structural rule handoff telemetry for axis, length, thickness, transforms, clipping, border style, opacity, and paint identity. Wide/phone material and native rules match in style and thickness with about 0.016 px length residual, ruling out rule geometry as the visible jerk cause.

slices.title: handoff-ownership-timing
slices.summary: Proved exclusive atomic ownership through the endpoint with reverse/direct-seek equality. At 99.9% material glyph boxes and structural rules are subpixel-close to native while the persistent plus retains a style mismatch and roughly 1.63 px maximum baseline residual, isolating the jerk to paint adaptation rather than handoff timing.

slices.title: generic-alignment-model
slices.summary: Added a pure fail-closed common-translation model. It returns a bounded correction only when every paired paint atom agrees in paint, style, shape, and delta; the measured persistent plus font-size mismatch is explicitly unsupported, proving one scene translation cannot repair the endpoint without a disallowed per-atom adaptation.
